Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the first president of the country containing the Kamchatka Peninsula (Russia) as Boris Yeltsin in the very first step. While Yeltsin was the first President of the *Russian Federation* (1991), he was not the first president of the country where Kamchatka is located if one considers the historical continuity of the state from the dissolution of the USSR. More critically, the Planner's initial reasoning was flawed because it immediately settled on Yeltsin without fully verifying the distinction between the RSFSR presidency (which Yeltsin held starting in 1990) and the Russian Federation presidency, nor did it initially consider that Mikhail Gorbachev was the first person to hold the title "President of the Soviet Union" (1990–1991) before the entity ceased to exist. Although the Planner later corrected itself to include Gorbachev, the initial error in Step 1 led to a confused investigation path where the agent repeatedly searched for Yeltsin and Gorbachev separately rather than synthesizing the correct answer based on the specific definition of "first president" of the sovereign entity (Russia/Russian Federation vs. USSR). The most direct error was the premature and incomplete conclusion in Step 1 that Yeltsin was the standard answer without sufficient nuance regarding the timeline of the "President" title in the region.
